checks.detail: Primary outcome is proposed until selected; pilot success is not value acceptance.
Finite fractions and explicitly selected thresholds required; no invented default benefit threshold.
All three partitions and declared ancestry required. Renamed pilot fixtures are not unseen families.
Declared ancestry alone does not prove independent populations or absence of near duplicates.
An explicit reviewed independent-unit design is required; seed count is not sample adequacy.
Name a real operator and paired task/order plan; no simulated human baseline.
One fresh-support query gives general fixed/adaptive identical behavior; learning requires a separately reviewed schedule.
Freeze executable sources, data, policies, budgets and stopping rules before held-out inspection.
The current CLI deliberately rejects held-out/confirmatory execution. A reviewed adapter is not implemented.

limits: Local declarations are not signed reviewer attestations.
This diagnostic does not certify sample adequacy, dataset independence or permission to score.
